posts.englishTextAsDisplayed:
EN: Do you want to build smart electronic devices, wireless robots, and IoT applications? Join RobotYOUNG Academy’s ESP32 Class, where hands-on learning helps you turn coding and electronics knowledge into real-world projects.

🎯 What Will You Learn?

🔹 ESP32 Architecture & Microcontroller Programming

🔹 Coding with the Arduino IDE

🔹 Wireless Communication using Wi-Fi, Bluetooth & ESP-NOW

🔹 Building browser-controlled Web Servers

🔹 Connecting to REST APIs & MQTT for IoT applications

🔹 Developing Smart Devices, Wireless Robotics & IoT Systems

🔹 Designing, building, testing, and presenting your own technology project

📅 Class Enrollment/Start Date: 24 October 2026

📍 Location: Connexion Building, Koh Pich Street, Phnom Penh, Cambodia

📞 For More Information: +855 15 999 187

🔥 Ready to take your coding and electronics skills to the next level? Enroll today and start building the future with ESP32!

📩 Contact RobotYOUNG Academy today to learn more and secure your place!
